# Pictory

> Turn one plain-language sentence into a finished image by answering a few visual multiple-choice questions — no prompt writing, no re-rolling the dice.

Pictory is a visual decision-tree AI image tool. Instead of asking users to write a 200-word prompt and re-generate 6–10 times, it:
1. takes one sentence (e.g. "a girl and a dog running at sunset"),
2. automatically decomposes it into visual elements (VISTA schema: character / environment / lighting / composition / camera / style / effects),
3. renders 2–4 real candidate images per element so the user just clicks to choose,
4. lets the user refine any node by chatting,
5. composes one final high-quality image (FLUX.1 Pro).

## Why it is different

- Traditional text-to-image: write a long prompt, roll the dice 8 times, ~20 minutes, $0.15–0.40 per usable image.
- Pictory: one sentence + a few clicks, 2–5 minutes, ~$0.10 per finished piece.
- 18 cheap preview images are *decision aids*; the expensive final image is generated only once.

## Key pages

- / : Landing page with the value proposition and pricing entry
- /create : The creation workspace — sentence input, element decision tree, candidate grids, final image
- /gallery : Public gallery of shared works (growth flywheel)
- /pricing : Free / Starter / Pro plans and credit packs

## Plans

- Free: $0, 60 credits/month (≈6 works), watermarked, FLUX.1 schnell previews, 2 Pro final-image trials
- Starter: $9.9/mo, 600 credits, Pro final image, no watermark, personal commercial license
- Pro: $29/mo, 2400 credits, priority queue, private generation

## Compliance

- All final images retain machine-readable C2PA provenance metadata.
- Deepfake-class outputs (e.g. editing a real person's photo) carry a visible "AI generated" label (EU AI Act Art. 50(4)).
- Text and image moderation run server-side on every request, identical standards for free and paid users.
- Reference-image uploads require just-in-time granular consent; images are deleted after processing.

## Tech

Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind, Supabase (Postgres + Auth + RLS), Creem (Merchant of Record, VAT handled), fal.ai FLUX (schnell for previews, Pro for final), deployed on Vercel.
